description: Inert text-level and grouping elements (M6 breadth sweep, P1): sup, sub, kbd, samp, mark, time, data, abbr, dfn, var, del, ins, s, u, blockquote, cite and address with their user-agent styles, inserted, removed and updated by state

knownGaps.pixels: The line of del, ins, s and u (region edit) differs by 2.6-3.6/255 at 800px and 4.1-5.7/255 at 420px: with identical glyphs, Blitz places the underline one device pixel higher and the line-through one lower than Chromium (both snapped to whole pixels; Blitz rounds its offsets from the unrounded baseline; docs/BLITZ-GAPS.md, text decorations). The rest of the page is within 1.1/255
